_about: Sensors PLANNED for the KoolKisaan Flowers room (types, ranges and accuracies are typical catalogue values, E). Nothing is installed yet: every value on the website is simulated by the digital twin, not measured.

sensors.name: Outside air temperature
sensors.type: SHT31 digital T/RH sensor in a radiation shield
sensors.location: Weather mast, 1.5 m high, 1.5 m south-east of the room
sensors.used_in: Q_wall = U·A·(T_out − T_in); door infiltration enthalpy h_out; T_cond = T_out + 10 K; PV cell temperature

sensors.name: Outside relative humidity
sensors.location: Weather mast, in the radiation shield
sensors.used_in: Humidity ratio W_out → enthalpy h_out → door latent load

sensors.name: Wind speed
sensors.location: Top of the weather mast, 2.2 m
sensors.used_in: Logged for context (wind raises door infiltration in real rooms; not in the ASHRAE formula)

sensors.name: Solar PV power
sensors.location: PV combiner, on the canopy frame
sensors.used_in: P = P_rated·(G/1000)·PR·[1 − 0.004·(T_cell − 25)]; decides solar vs grid (ATS)

sensors.name: Chiller + pump power
sensors.location: Outdoor chiller unit
sensors.used_in: COP_elec = Q_cooling / P_comp; physics check of room temperature

sensors.name: Grid backup switch (ATS)
sensors.type: Contact on the automatic transfer switch
sensors.location: Control box, north wall
sensors.used_in: Grid backup hours; switches when ice < 15 % and no sun

sensors.name: Door switch
sensors.location: Top of the door frame, handle side
sensors.used_in: D_t = fraction of time open → Q_door = q·D_t·D_f·(1 − E)

sensors.name: Room temperature – low
sensors.location: Back wall, 0.3 m high
sensors.used_in: Room air temperature (the twin has ONE air node, so all room sensors show the same value in SIMULATED mode)

sensors.name: Room T / RH – middle
sensors.location: Back wall, 1.2 m high
sensors.used_in: Main control sensor; Q_wall, door enthalpy h_in, shelf life

sensors.name: Room temperature – high
sensors.location: Back wall, 2.0 m high
sensors.used_in: Stratification check (warm air collects at the top)

sensors.name: Air leaving the glycol air cooler
sensors.location: Under the air cooler, back wall
sensors.used_in: Coil performance check

sensors.name: Ice panel temperature
sensors.type: Type-T thermocouple in the ice + MAX31856
sensors.location: Inside an ice panel, west wall
sensors.used_in: ice battery state (with the energy balance) and backup time

sensors.name: Flower (core of the crate) temperature
sensors.location: Inside the newest crate, among the flowers
sensors.used_in: Product pull-down: Q = m·cp·dT/dt; shelf-life model

sensors.name: Ethylene / VOC gas (optional)
sensors.location: Back wall, 1.6 m high
sensors.used_in: Ripening / spoilage trend only. NOT simulated – shows a value only when a real sensor is connected.

sensors.name: Glycol supply temperature
sensors.type: PT100 / DS18B20 in a pocket on the pipe
sensors.location: Glycol pipe leaving the plate exchanger (outside wall)
sensors.used_in: Q = m_dot × cp × (T_return − T_supply): the glycol energy-balance check

sensors.name: Glycol return temperature
sensors.type: PT100 / DS18B20 in a pocket on the pipe
sensors.location: Glycol pipe coming back to the plate exchanger
sensors.used_in: Q = m_dot × cp × (T_return − T_supply)

sensors.name: Glycol flow
sensors.location: Glycol supply pipe after the pump
sensors.used_in: Glycol energy-balance check; pump health

sensors.name: Room relative humidity
sensors.type: SHT31 / capacitive RH sensor rated for 95 %+
sensors.location: Back wall, 1.2 m high, away from the fogger
sensors.used_in: Fogger on below 90 %, off at 95 %; flower water loss

sensors.name: R290 leak sensor
sensors.location: Low on the OUTDOOR chiller unit (propane is heavier than air)
sensors.used_in: Alarm and chiller stop; there is no R290 inside the room

sensors.name: V-ROOM valve position
sensors.location: Glycol branch to the air cooler
sensors.used_in: Controller: room first

sensors.name: V-ICE valve position
sensors.location: Glycol branch to the ice panels
sensors.used_in: Controller: only with spare solar and ice below 100 %
